concepts.gloss_en: the zeal/jealousy for the Lord of Hosts — the act of being zealous on God's behalf (counted as tzedakah)

members.note: representative; construct head is קנאה (zeal), the act of being zealous

concepts.gloss_en: the Lord of Hosts — the divine name/attribute itself, invoked as the model of piety to emulate

members.note: the divine name itself, not an action about it

notes: Different construct heads: קנאת ה' צבאות (the zeal FOR Hashem Tzevaot) is a state/action, whereas ה' צבאות is the divine name itself. Per rule 4, an action/state about X is not X. Also used in different Torahs (lm2:65 vs lm1:31) with distinct senses. Token overlap only; kept separate.
